inputs.text: This isn’t just a Liberal leadership spat. It’s about a party choosing to protect tax advantages for gas companies and property investors instead of seriously considering reform—while ordinary people bear the consequences of entrenched wealth. Angus Taylor shutting down Andrew Hastie’s call makes those priorities hard to miss. And on the US and Israel’s war with Iran, Taylor wouldn’t say whether he supported it or repeat Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump. The public deserves leaders who are clear about military force and willing to challenge powerful interests at home.
